DescriptionNotifySync: Manage notifications and category quotas for the bell icon.
DescQuota: Sets the number of items to keep for EACH type (e.g., 5 Movies + 5 Series + 5 Music).
DescMonitoredLibraries: Check the libraries to display in the bell.
DescCategoryMapping: Create your own categories (e.g., Documentaries, Anime).
DescManualSelection: If the checkboxes above don't work, enter the ID OR EXACT NAME of the folder here.
DescMaintenance: Click here after changing libraries to force a scan.
